refnamediv.refpurpose: Set or retrieve user data pointer of an event loop object

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: sd_event_set_userdata() may be used to set an arbitrary user data pointer for the event loop object specified as event. The userdata parameter specifies the new user data pointer to set, the function returns the previous user data pointer. Note that NULL is a valid user data pointer. By default, no user data pointer is set, i.e. it is NULL.
sd_event_get_userdata() may be used to query the current user data pointer assigned to the event loop object event.

This is similar to sd_event_source_set_userdata3, but operates on the event loop object itself rather than on an individual event source. It is useful to associate application-specific context with an event loop, for example in order to access it from handler callbacks that only have access to the event loop object.

refsect1.title: Return Value
refsect1.para: On success, sd_event_set_userdata() returns the previous user data pointer, and sd_event_get_userdata() returns the current user data pointer. On failure, they return NULL.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: sd_event_set_userdata() and sd_event_get_userdata() were added in version 263.
